title: The fail-closed ungoverned-opt-out condition, as structured violations
intent: :func:`assert_app_clean` refuses (with a plain ``AssertionError``) to honour any ``# arch-allow-*`` marker when no escape-hatch budget governs it. This is the same condition projected as :class:`ArchViolation` values (rule ``ungoverned_escape_hatch``, one per marker line), so a structured renderer (``terp check --format json``) reports it in-band instead of crashing.
